answer: In an agent economy commissioning a pigment mural of a comet above a knoll, each agent must lock a refundable bond for 90 days to vote on payments. Voting weight is proportional to the amount bonded, with no bonus for opening an account. Splitting one bond among a thousand fake identities gives no extra influence: an attacker seeking more votes must lock more capital, paying its financing cost and losing access to it for the full term.
